Light armor. AC 11 + Dex modifier(Dis Stealth).

This type of coat is made from durable fabrics and materials that provide basic protection.

Light armor. AC 11 + Dex modifier.

Thicker shirts consist of high-quality quilted cloth or leather that don't hinder flexibility.

Light armor. AC 12 + Dex modifier.

An undershirt consisting of durable synthetic fibers that provides noticeable protection against bullets and other weapons.

Medium armor. AC 12 + Dex modifier (max 2).

This crude armor is made from various thick beast skins and pelts. Tribal groups, evil humanoids, and savages often wear this type of material for protection.

Medium armor. AC 13 + Dex modifier (max 2).

A protective jacket consisting of durable synthetic fibers that provides decent protection against bullets and other weapons without making too much noise.

Medium armor. AC 15 + Dex modifier (max 2).

This armor consists of fully bulletproof materials made from durable synthetic fibers. Your vital organs are completely protected by this suit, though your legs and arms are left partially uncovered.

Heavy armor. AC 14(Disadvantage on Stealth).

This armor is leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armor against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can’t afford better armor.

Heavy armor. AC 16(Disadvantage on Stealth).

Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

Heavy armor. AC 18(Disadvantage on Stealth).

Consists of shaped, interlocking steel plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, giant shoulder plates, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor. Sometimes it comes with a coating.

Many warrior-type sorcerers supplement their armor with a Shield. A Shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a Shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one Shield at a time.

Contains a hiking backpack, sleeping bag, portable stove, lighter, flashlight, 10 spare batteries, 10 pre-packaged meals, a canteen, 60 feet of climbing rope and an energy tag made by fermenting in cursed energy for 100 years. You can rip the charm to regain 3 cursed energy.
Contains a heavy-duty duffel bag, crowbar, utility hammer, climbing spikes, flashlight, 10 glowsticks, lighter, 10 ready meals, hydration pack, 60 feet of durable rope, and a basic cursed tool knife.

Contains a compact backpack, steel bearings, nylon wire, small bell alarm, compact crowbar, hammer, climbing hooks, flashlight, 2 bottles of oil, 5 energy bars, lighter, water bottle, 60 feet of rope, and a bundle of binding cord.

Contains a sleek suitcase, two document tubes, formal attire, fountain pen, ink refills, smartphone, two spare batteries, five parchment sheets, perfume, wax seal kit, a bar of soap, and a cursed seal stamp.
Contains a duffel bag, sleeping bag, two performance outfits, makeup kit, five candles, five snacks, a water bottle, a disguise kit, and a trick mirror.
Contains a modern exorcist’s satchel, prayer mat, 10 candles, lighter, alms box, two incense blocks, censer, priest robes, two meals, a water bottle, and a cursed lantern.

Contains a sturdy backpack, notebook, tablet or laptop, stylus pen, 10 sheets of blank paper, sandbag eraser, small utility knife, and a curse detector.
Cursed Tools
Items, both brand new items and others from antiquity who are embedded with curses, since normal weapons cannot damage cursed spirits. These weapons are organized by grade 4th grade(Common), 3rd grade(Uncommon), 2nd grade(Rare), 1st grade(Very Rare), Special grade(Legendary).
A modern cellphone.

4th Grade category rule.

These items are just simple weapons and day to day objects imbued with cursed energy, thus they are able to hurt things such as curses.
These are glasses with lenses embedded with cursed energy allowing those who wear it to see curses if they otherwise would not be able to.

A bundle of cord soaked with the blood of cursed spirits and carries a pungent smell. Low grade curses cannot phase through these cords as they can with most physical objects and can therefore be used to bind and restrain them.
A small handheld mirror. Normally curses do not have reflections and do not appear in photographs. However, using this trick mirror, you can see curses in the mirror’s reflection.

3rd Grade category rule.

These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by gaining a +1 bonus to related activities.

3rd Grade category rule.

Items that hold an innate technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are all 5e Uncommon items that aren't +1 items.

An ordinary steel blade etched with faint markings that allow it to cut low-grade curses or weak barriers. The knife counts as a 4th grade cursed tool. While within 5 ft of a barrier, you can spend half a minute to discreetly cut a 5 ft hole in a Basic Curtain or similarly weak barrier without alerting the one who placed it. You can use the knife in this way three times before it breaks and becomes unusable.

A small device resembling a geiger counter with a simple screen. You can use this item to gain advantage on a Wisdom or Cursed Energy (Perception) check to locate residuals, curses and cursed energy. On a success, you can track where the cursed energy trail leads you and you are aware of whose cursed energy it is if you are familiar with them. The DC equals the cursed energy save DC of the creature being tracked. You can use this item a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus before it needs to be recharged by spending 1 cursed energy.

A small paper lantern inlaid with paper tags to detect cursed energy. You can spend 1 cursed energy to light the lantern for 1 hour. It glows brighter when near cursed energy and sputters violently when near a cursed spirit, shikigami, or cursed corpse.

2nd Grade category rule.

These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by adding a +2 to related things.

2nd Grade category rule.

Items that hold a technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are 5e Rare items that aren't +2.

Weapon (Shortsword), Grade 2
When attacking with the Cursed Hand Sword you gain a +2 to attack and damage rolls and advantage on ability checks or saving throws against being disarmed of this weapon.
You can choose to remotely control it to move and attack as a bonus action. The weapon moves up to 25 feet and makes one attack per turn and remains active while within 100 ft. When attacking remotely, use your Cursed Energy modifier for attack rolls, and deal 2d10 slashing damage (no ability modifier). You can command it to travel somewhere or target a creature as an action, not requiring actions.

A small stamp with the seal of your sorcerer clan or a different organization you are affiliated with. By spending 1 cursed energy, you can stamp a contract with your seal to agree to a binding vow within the contents of a contract. These are usually used for long and complicated binding vows or to make a binding vow without meeting in person. If the contract or the contents of the contract is changed or altered in any way, the stamp is invalidated and must be reapplied.

1st Grade category rule.

These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by adding a +3 to related activities.

1st Grade category rule.

Items that hold an innate technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are all 5e Very Rare items.

Weapon(Scimitar), Grade 1

Once per turn, you can gain a bonus to an attack or damage roll made with this cursed tool equal to 1/3 of the slashing damage dealt by your last attack (rounded down).

Weapon(Gauntlets), Grade 1

When attacking with the Claws of Calamity you gain a +3 to attack and damage rolls, and deal 1d12 bludgeoning, slashing or piercing damage. The damage required for Limb Removal for arms increases by 20.

Weapon(Whip), Grade 1

When you attack using this weapon you can use a charge that makes it so all magic and cursed energy features are deactivated. However, for every hit this effect is active, you subtract one from your hit and damage bonus, once you reach a -5 Black Rope will burn away.

Special Grade category rule.

These items are filled with Cursed Energy which allows them to become more effective. This is represented by adding a +4 to related things.

Special Grade category rule.

Items that hold an innate technique are found in many different grades of strength. Mechanically, these are all 5e Legendary and above items.

Weapon(Weighted Chain), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. In addition, as a bonus action, you can add 60ft to the range as long as one end is covered. You can also add a light weapon to the chain’s end.

Weapon(Shortsword), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. On a hit with this weapon, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take 6d10 necrotic damage.

Weapon(Dagger), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. All magic and cursed energy-related features are deactivated against this weapon.

Weapon(Three Segment Staff), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. In addition while wielding this weapon you gain a +1 bonus to AC and on a hit you gain a bonus to damage equal to 3 times your (Strength modifier + 4).

Weapon(Katana), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. Attacks made with this weapon ignores resistances and immunities and damage from this sword reduces the maximum hit points of the target until a long rest.

Weapon(Shortsword), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this cursed tool. On a hit, a cursed spirit must make a DC 30 Constitution saving throw, being exorcised instantaneously on a failed save.

Weapon (Any), Grade 4

This is any weapon that has been imbued with a curse, allowing it to damage curses or shikigami.

Cursed Item(Ammunition), Grade 4

A creature hit by this ammunition must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Cursed Item, Grade 4

Three small, crystal beads are strung on this leather bracelet. As an action, you can pluck one bead from the bracelet to gain Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks for 1 minute. A bead disappears immediately after it’s plucked. Once all three beads have been plucked, the bracelet loses its magic.

description.value:
Cursed Item, Grade 4

This tiny vial contains perfume laced with cursed energy, enough for one use. You can take an action to apply the perfume to yourself, and its effect lasts 1 hour. For the duration, you have Advantage on all Charisma (Deception and Persuasion) checks made to influence a creature within 5 feet of yourself.

Cursed Item, Grade 4

While you’re wearing this fearsome steel helm, your eyes glow red and the rest of your face is hidden in shadow. Any checks to determine your identity from your face are impossible.

Cursed Item, Grade 4

This copper amulet contains tiny interlocking gears and is powered by cursed energy from an unknown technique. Faint ticking and whirring noises emanate from within. When you make an attack roll while wearing the amulet, you can forgo rolling the d20 to get a 10 on the die. Once used, this property can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Potion, Grade 4

Shredded food meal made from the ground up bodies of low grade curses. A shikigami can eat this as an action to regain 2d4+2 hit points.

Weapon (Any), Grade 3

This is any weapon that has been imbued with a curse, allowing it to damage curses or shikigami. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

Cursed Item, Grade 3 (Requires Attunement)

This item belonged to a famous swimmer that was afraid of water and cursed it upon drowning. While wearing this cloak or jacket, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

description.value:
Cursed Item, Grade 3

Apply to an item, container, or door to make a Minor Magical Lock for 8 hours (DC 18 to open). The talisman cannot be removed while active and is expended after the 8 hours are complete.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

As an action you channel cursed energy into the paper charm to create a flat black barrier in the shape of a 5 ft square within 10 ft of you for 1 minute and expends the talisman. The barrier has an AC of 15, 30 hit points and automatically fails saving throws. It also has immunity to poison or psychic damage.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

As an action, you can attempt to slap this paper charm onto a cursed spirit. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d8 radiant damage on a hit and expending the talisman. This talisman only functions against cursed spirits.

Cursed Item, Grade 3 (Requires Attunement)

While wearing these prayer beads, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

Amplify Technique. You can spend up to 3 CE when you use a cursed technique to increase the save DC by 1 for each CE spent. Once used, you cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

A small bell that when rung, it sounds like a deafening wailing. You can spend 1 CE as an action to ring the bell. All cursed spirits within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 thunder damage.

Cursed Item(Ammunition), Grade 3

Ranged weapon attack rolls made with this ammunition ignore half and three-quarters cover. In addition, attacking at long range doesn’t impose disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls made with this ammunition.

Armor (light, medium, or heavy), Grade 3(requires attunement)

A set armor imbued with curses containing fear of heights. While you wear this armor, you can use a bonus action to expend 2 or more cursed energy to cast one of the following spells from the armor, targeting yourself: Jump (2 ce) or Levitate (4 ce).

Cursed item (tattoo), rarity varies (requires attunement)

Tattoo Attunement. To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin. If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.

Protection. While you aren't wearing armor, the tattoo grants you an Armor Class depending on the tattoo's rarity, as shown below. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit. Rarity AC Grade 3 13 + your Dexterity modifier Grade 2 16 + your Dexterity modifier (maximum of +2)

Grade 1 20

Weapon(Spear), Grade 3

A weapon steeped in blood and curses for years. When you hit with a melee attack using this cursed spear and reduce the target to 0 hit points, you gain 2d6 temporary hit points.

Weapon(Any Ammunition or Melee Weapon), Grade 3

This weapon or piece of ammunition has an inlaid talisman that automatically imbues the weapon with cursed energy. Whenever this weapon or piece of ammunition hits a Construct (such as a Cursed Corpse) or object, the hit is a Critical Hit.

Cursed Item, Grade 3 (Requires Attunement)

This smooth, oval stone is etched with faintly glowing, magical symbols. A creature can make a DC 15 Intelligence (History) check to determine that these runes are reminiscent of the norse shamans. While attuned to the item, at the start of a long rest you can store cursed energy within the battery up to your proficiency bonus + your Cursed Energy modifier and the battery is considered full. This cursed energy cannot be regained until you finish a long rest. While holding the battery, you can take an action to touch the battery to immediately regain the stored cursed energy.

Weapon(Any), Grade 3

A weapon that has been saturated in an unusually dense cursed energy for a long period of time. On a hit, this weapon deals an additional d6 necrotic damage and the target cannot regain hit points until the end of its turn.

Weapon(Gauntlet), Grade 3(Requires Attunement)

These gauntlets are imbued with the accumulated fear of the mythical Oni. Your Strength is 17 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is 17 or higher without them.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

This item is made from a scrapped cursed corpse and possesses a living eye attached to it that is constantly searching the area. While wearing this item, you have advantage on Initiative rolls.

description.value:
Cursed Item, Grade 3

While holding this monocle up to your eye, you can spend 2 cursed energy to gain the benefits of Comprehend Languages for 1 minute while looking through the monocle.

Mind Sharpener Ring, Grade 3(Requires Attunement) As iron sharpens iron, so does a friend sharpen friend. When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can spend 1 CE as a Reaction to succeed instead.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

A Repurposed Cursed Corpse is a bottle containing a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take an action to throw the bottle to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the bottle smashes and the figurine grows and becomes a cursed corpse specified in the description below(as a construct). If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn’t enough space for the creature, the statuette doesn’t become a creature. The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions. The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 Hit Points or if you take an action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can’t be used again until the bottle has reformed around the cursed corpse, as specified in the figurine’s description. Ebony Fly (Grade 3) This ebony statuette, carved in the likeness of a horsefly, can become a Giant Fly for up to 12 hours and can be ridden as a mount. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 2 days have passed. Onyx Dog (Grade 3) This onyx statuette of a dog can become a Mastiff for up to 6 hours. The mastiff has an Intelligence of 8 and can speak Common. It also has Blindsight with a range of 60 feet. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 7 days have passed. Silver Raven (Grade 3) This silver statuette of a raven can become a Raven for up to 12 hours. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 2 days have passed. While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it. Serpentine Owl (Grade 3) This serpentine statuette of an owl can become a Giant Owl for up to 8 hours. The owl can communicate telepathically with you at any range if you and it are on the same plane of existence. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 2 days have passed.

Cursed Item, Grade 3(Requires Attunement)

A small necklace with the symbol of a wheel with eight grips. While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

Potion, Grade 3

A muscle steroid spiked with cursed energy. After you drink this, each Unarmed Strike you make deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage on a hit. This effect lasts 10 minutes. This potion is a thick green fluid that tastes like spinach.

Weapon(Dagger), Grade 3

As a bonus action for 2 cursed energy, you coat the blade of this Dagger with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

Weapon(Any Weapon with Thrown property), Grade 3

This weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and it returns to your hand immediately after you use it to make a ranged attack roll.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

This saddle confers the following benefits while you are seated in it and astride a mount.

  • Attack rolls against the mount have Disadvantage.

  • You can’t be dismounted against your will. This property is suppressed while you have the Incapacitated condition.

Potion, Grade 3

Shredded food meal made from the ground up bodies of low grade curses. A shikigami can eat this as an action to regain 4d4+4 hit points.

Armor(shield), Grade 3

Crude metal spikes adorn this cursed Shield. It has the following properties that you can use while holding it.

Shield Bash. When you take the Attack action, you can make one of the attack rolls using the Shield against a target within 5 feet of yourself. Apply your Proficiency Bonus and Strength modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, the Shield deals Piercing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier.

Spike Salvo. As an action for 3 cursed energy, you can cause spikes to erupt from the Shield in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

This curved staff is obviously a cursed corpse in the shape of a snake. Its stiffened body lets it be used as a quarterstaff. As an action, you can throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, causing the staff to become a Giant Venomous Snake (Construct) in that space. The snake is under your control and shares your Initiative count, taking its turn immediately after yours. On your turn, you can mentally command the snake (no action required) if it is within 60 feet of you and you don’t have the Incapacitated condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. Absent commands from you, the snake defends itself. As a Bonus Action, you can command the snake to revert to staff form in its current space, and you can’t use the staff’s property again for 1 hour. If the snake is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it dies and reverts to its staff form; the staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its Hit Points, it regains all of them.

Potion, Grade 3

A pouch of purified salt contains 1d4+1 pinches of salt. As an action, you can scatter up to 5 pinches of salt and each pinch covers a 5 ft area. Cursed Spirits of Grade 3 or lower are unwilling to cross the line of salt.

Weapon(Dagger), Grade 3

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon. On a hit, it deals an additional 1d4 necrotic damage.

Cursed Item, Grade 3

While this item is worn by a cursed spirit or shikigami, they gain a +10 ft bonus to walking speed.

Cursed Shot Ammunition, Grade 3 You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this ammunition. On a miss, you can use your reaction to reroll the attack roll against a target within 15 ft of the original target. After being fired, the ammunition loses its mystical properties.

Weapon (Any), Grade 2

This is any weapon that has been imbued with a curse, allowing it to damage curses or shikigami. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

Cursed Item, Grade 2

A small handheld clay jar that acts as a vessel to trap a cursed spirit. As an action you can force a cursed spirit within 5 feet to make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they are sealed within the jar.

  • A cursed spirit with a CR lower than 1 automatically fails.

  • A cursed spirit with a CR higher than 2 automatically succeeds. The jar can hold a number of cursed spirits with a combined CR equal to 5. If the jar is destroyed, all contained cursed spirits are released.

Weapon (War Fan), Grade 2

A ceremonial paper fan that appears ancient, but well maintained. It has been imbued with potent curses and can be properly used as a weapon. This paper fan can be used as a +1 War Fan with the addition of the finesse property and on a hit, it deals 1d8 slashing damage.

Retribution. As a reaction to taking damage, you can spend 2 CE to make a melee or ranged spell attack against the creature that damaged you if they are within 30 feet and on a hit you deal 4d8 slashing damage and the target's movement speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

Weapon (Knuckle Dusters), Grade 2

A pair of flashy silver knuckle dusters engraved with imagery of a monstrous dragonfly. When you take the Attack action with this weapon, you can make an additional attack using the knuckles as part of the attack action. Once per turn you can deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage on a hit. If you score a critical hit against a creature using these knuckles, that creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of their turn.

Armor(Medium or Heavy), Grade 2

This suit of armor is embedded with cursed talisman that automatically reinforce the armor with cursed energy. While you're wearing it, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

Cursed Item, Grade 2

This rope is 30 feet long and weighs 3 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak its command word, the other end darts forward to entangle a creature you can see within 20 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become restrained. You can release the creature by using a bonus action to speak a second command word. A target restrained by the rope can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check (target’s choice). On a success, the creature is no longer restrained by the rope. The rope has AC 20 and 20 hit points. It regains 1 hit point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 hit point. If the rope drops to 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

Cursed Item(Any Instrument), Grade 2(Requires Attunement)

An instrument that once belonged to a world-wide famous musician. You can spend 1 CE to gain a +3 bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks to perform with this instrument for 1 hour. If attuned to by a creature with an Innate Technique relating to music, they gain a +2 bonus to their Cursed Energy save DC and Cursed Energy attack rolls relating to their Innate Technique.

Weapon(Dagger), Grade 2(Requires Attunement)

This weapon deals 1d6 damage on a hit. As a reaction to an attack made against you, you can roll 1d6 and add the result to your AC against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss. If this causes the attack to miss, you can make an attack with the Tanto as part of the reaction if the creature is within range.

Honorable Death. As an action while holding the tanto, you can commit Seppuku and disembowel yourself with the weapon. You die without any saving throws and after 5 rounds (10 minutes if out of combat) have passed, you return as a Vengeful Cursed Spirit under the effects of Indefinite Madness as stated in Cursed Upon Death. Your Hit Points equal your Hit Points at the moment of Honorable Death, unless they were lower than half your maximum hit points, in which case your Hit Points equal half your maximum. Once used, this property does not function for 1 year and must build up resentment.

Cursed Item, Grade 2

A Repurposed Cursed Corpse is a bottle containing a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take an action to throw the bottle to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the bottle smashes and the figurine grows and becomes a cursed corpse specified in the description below(as a construct). If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn’t enough space for the creature, the statuette doesn’t become a creature. The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions. The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 Hit Points or if you take an action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can’t be used again until the bottle has reformed around the cursed corpse, as specified in the figurine’s description. Golden Lions (Grade 2) These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously. Each can become a Lion for up to 1 hour. Once a lion has been used, it can’t be used again until 7 days have passed. Marble Elephant (Grade 2) This marble statuette resembles a trumpeting elephant. It can become an Elephant for up to 24 hours. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 7 days have passed. Bronze Griffon (Grade 2) This bronze statuette is of a griffon rampant. It can become a Griffon for up to 6 hours. Once it has been used, it can’t be used again until 5 days have passed.

Potion, Grade 2

Shredded food meal made from the ground up bodies of medium grade curses. A shikigami can eat this as an action to regain 8d4+8 hit points and gain advantage on the next attack roll or skill check it makes.

+3 Cursed Weapon This is any weapon that has been imbued with a curse, allowing it to damage curses or shikigami. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

Weapon(Greatsword), Grade 1

When attacking with the Demon-Culling Greatsword, you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the weapon deals an additional 2d6 necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the target loses a limb (d4).

Weapon (Scimitar), Grade 1

When attacking with the Tempest Ring, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. As an action, you can spend 3 CE to force creatures in a 60 ft cone to make a Dexterity saving (DC 17) or take 8d6 slashing damage on a failed save or half as much as a successful save.

Weapon (Gauntlets), Grade 1 (requires attunement)

Your Constitution score is 20 while you wield these gauntlets. This property of the gauntlets has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 20 or higher. After making a successful unarmed strike while wielding these gauntlets, you are able to target vitality and can deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage to the target, and you can spend 1 CE to regain a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt. Alternatively, instead of regaining hit points in this way, you can choose to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw you make before the end of your next turn.

Armor(Any), Grade 1

While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC and resistance to Necrotic damage. Additionally, as a reaction to being hit by necrotic damage or a cursed technique, you can roll 4d4 and reduce the damage by that amount.

Weapon(Quarterstaff), Grade 1

This acts as a Quarterstaff with the Reach property. You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls and on a hit you deal an additional 1d12 lightning damage. If wielded by a creature with Mythical Beast Amber, once per turn they can spend 1 cursed energy as a free action to give the staff a positive charge. As an action, you can release a lightning bolt to the staff if it is within 30 ft of you. All creatures between you and the staff must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Cursed Energy save DC, taking 1d12 lightning damage per charge on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

Potion, Grade 1

Shredded food meal made from the ground up bodies of high grade curses. A shikigami can eat this as an action to regain 10d4+20 hit points and gain advantage on attack rolls and skill checks for 1 minute.

Cursed Tool, Grade 1(Requires Attunement)

As an action, you can attach this zipper aglet to a nonmagical object or structure and zip or unzip it to create a 5 ft hole until the zipper is detached. A creature attuned to this item can temporarily reattach a severed limb with the zipper.

Weapon(Longsword), Grade 1

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon. On a critical hit with this weapon, the target loses 1d4 cursed energy that is absorbed by the sword. The sword can absorb up to 6 cursed energy. Once per turn, you can spend up to 3 cursed energy to gain a bonus to an attack roll you make with this weapon equal to the cursed energy spent.

Weapon(Katana), First Grade

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon. When you make an attack roll or saving throw, you can gain advantage on the roll as the tormented spirits within the blade grant you favor. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus each long rest.

Any cursed tool is imbued with a technique and has a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Weapon(Club), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon. You can spend up to 10 cursed energy as an action to send out a blast of lightning against up to 5 creatures within 120 ft. Each creature must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d12 lightning damage per CE spent or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature that gets a 10 or less on the save is paralyzed until the end of their next turn.

Weapon(Trident), Special Grade

You have a +4 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon. When you are hit by an attack, you can make a melee or thrown attack with this weapon at advantage as a reaction. On a hit, the creature is knocked prone. If thrown, Hiten returns to your hand after the attack.

Weapon(Weighted Chain), Special Grade

These chains become indestructible when physically binding a creature with strong cursed energy. While wielding this weapon, you can use your action to make an attack roll using your Cursed Energy modifier against a target within 50 ft. A creature bound this way cannot use cursed energy until they escape (escape DC 20). The DC increases by +1 for every 10 cursed energy the target currently has.

Potion, Special Grade

This impossibly rare peach allows the consumer to permanently increase their Cursed Energy. If the fruit has ripened for 3 years, your Cursed Energy maximum increases by 2. After 6 years, it increases by 3. After 9 years, eating this peach increases your Cursed energy by 5.
